about: The live model's out-of-sample prices with the weight block (4 Nov 2026, the owner: 'add the weight history to the live model and retrain'): greyhound/live.py's recipe (every engine block card-safe, the race simulator, the weight block, log(BSP), learning rate 0.05, from 2024, rescaled to the SP book), fitted before the first recorded day (6 Oct) and every day from it priced, published to greyhound.live.LIVE_OOS_PRICES for the early lay's forecast fit (greyhound.laytest.live_prices reads the prefix from the day's predictions; until it is published the log-BSP model's prices stand in).
